extracted.intended_audience: public company registrants, securities counsel, auditors, and investors
extracted.subtask_description: Final rules (Regulation S-K subpart 1500 and related amendments) defining the content, presentation, timing, assurance, and financial-statement treatment of climate-related disclosures required in SEC registration statements and annual reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of the Climate-Related Disclosures (Items 1500–1508)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require registrants to provide certain climate-related information in registration statements and annual reports; the final rules adopt Items 1500 through 1508 of Regulation S-K to specify topics to be disclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See section I and Table of Contents: 'Content of the Climate-Related Disclosures' (overview and detailed items). Disclosures must cover climate-related risks that have materially impacted, or are reasonably likely to have a material impact on, business strategy, results of operations, or financial condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation and Submission of the Climate-Related Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosures required by subpart 1500 must be provided in a part of the registration statement or annual report that is separately captioned as 'Climate-Related Disclosure.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A registrant may include responsive disclosure in other parts of the filing (e.g., Risk Factors, Business, MD&A), but should consider cross-referencing those disclosures in the separately captioned section to enhance presentation for investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe Harbor for Certain Climate-Related Disclosures (Item 1507)
rubrics_metrics.description: A safe harbor is established for certain climate-related disclosures to protect registrants under specified conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Item 1507 and section II.J in the release for scope, proposed rules, comments, and final rules regarding the safe harbor's applicability and limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase-in Periods / Compliance Date
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rules include effective date(s) and phase-in periods for compliance with various disclosure requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'DATES: Effective date' and section II.O. for transitional arrangements and explicit compliance timelines for different registrant categories and different items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions of Climate-Related Risks and Opportunities (Items 1500 and 1502(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide definitions and scope for 'climate-related risks' and 'climate-related opportunities' to guide registrants' disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See section II.C.1: proposed rule text, comments received, and final definitions adopted; definitions inform materiality assessments and disclosure scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time Horizons and the Materiality Determination (Item 1502(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and requirements on considering time horizons when determining whether climate-related risks are material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.C.2: addresses proposed rule, comments, and final rule on how registrants should evaluate short-, medium-, and long-term impacts in their materiality determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Impacts on Strategy, Business Model, and Outlook (Items 1502(b),(c),(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of how material climate-related risks affect a registrant’s strategy, business model, outlook, and operational or financial results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.D.1 for proposed rules, comments, and final rules explaining the scope of required narrative disclosure and examples of material impacts to be included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transition Plan Disclosure (Items 1500 and 1502(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant has a transition plan to address climate-related risks, it must disclose the plan and relevant details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.D.2: description of proposed requirements, commenter feedback, and the final rule specifying what aspects of transition plans must be reported (e.g., targets, timelines, implementation measures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Scenario Analysis If Used (Items 1500 and 1502(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant uses scenario analysis to assess climate-related risks, it must disclose that analysis and how it informs strategy/outlook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.D.3: registrants should disclose scenarios used, assumptions, time horizons, and how scenario outputs affected business planning, subject to the final rule's specificity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of a Maintained Internal Carbon Price (Item 1502(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant maintains an internal carbon price, it must disclose that price and how it is applied in planning and decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.D.4: proposed rule, comments, and final rule addressing required detail about the internal carbon price (level, application, changes over time).

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance Disclosure — Board Oversight (Item 1501(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of the board’s oversight of climate-related risks, including processes and frequency of oversight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.E.1 for proposed rules, comments, and final rule describing types of board-level information to disclose (e.g., roles, committees, how oversight is exercised).

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance Disclosure — Management Oversight (Item 1501(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of management’s role in assessing and managing climate-related risks, including delegations and processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.E.2: final rule sets expectations for describing management roles, internal reporting lines, and integration into operational decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk Management Disclosure (Item 1503)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of the registrant’s processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks and how these processes are integrated into overall risk management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.F: proposed rule, comments, and final rule detail the expected narrative on risk identification, monitoring, mitigation strategies, and escalation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targets and Goals Disclosure (Item 1504)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of climate-related targets and goals, progress toward them, and use of carbon offsets or renewable energy credits (RECs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.G: discusses the overall disclosure requirements, specifics on carbon offsets/RECs (Item 1504(d)), and how registrants should present target metrics and progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: GHG Emissions Disclosure (Item 1505)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions metrics (e.g., Scope 1, Scope 2, possibly Scope 3), underlying methodologies and assumptions, timeline for reporting, and permissible exclusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.H: includes presentation guidance, methodology and assumptions disclosure, timeline for reporting emissions metrics, exclusions from requirements, and when metrics are required to be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attestation over GHG Emissions Disclosure (Item 1506)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require attestation/assurance over GHG emissions disclosures with specific provider qualifications, engagement/report requirements, and additional registrant disclosures; includes treatment of voluntary assurance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.I: multi-part coverage — overview, provider requirements (Item 1506(b)), engagement/report requirements (Item 1506(a)(2) and (c)), additional registrant disclosure (Item 1506(d)), and voluntary assurance (Item 1506(e)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe Harbor for Certain Forward-Looking Climate Disclosures (Item 1507)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish legal safe harbor parameters for certain specified climate-related forward-looking statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.J for scope, proposed rules, public comments, and the final rule; explains which statements are covered and any limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Statement Effects — Article 14 (Rules 14-01, 14-02, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of financial statement effects of severe weather events and other natural conditions, including financial impact metrics, expenditures, recoveries, financial estimates and assumptions, opportunities, and inclusion of disclosures in the financial statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.K: detailed coverage of financial impact metrics, expenditure effects (scope, thresholds, attribution, recoveries), presentation, historical periods, financial estimates/assumptions, and whether disclosures belong in audited financial statements (Rule 14-01/14-02).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Climate-Related Disclosures in Financial Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify when climate-related information (e.g., certain effects of severe weather events) must be included in audited financial statements versus elsewhere in the filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.K.7 and related subsections: analysis of proposed rules, comments, and the final decision on inclusion and presentation in financial statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrants Subject to the Climate-Related Disclosure Rules and Affected Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify which registrants are subject to the rules (e.g., reporting companies under 13(a)/15(d)) and enumerate the SEC forms that are amended to require climate-related disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.L and the amendments list: Forms affected include S-1, S-3, S-11, S-4, F-3, F-4, Form 10, Form 20-F, Form 10-Q, Form 10-K, and related CFR citations; also discusses exemptions, SRCs/EGCs, and other scope issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured Data Requirement (Item 1508)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require certain climate-related disclosures to be provided in structured data (e.g., machine-readable tagging).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.M: proposed rule, comments, and final rules specifying which items must be tagged and the format/requirements for structured data submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment for Purposes of the Securities Act and the Exchange Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify whether the climate-related disclosures are considered 'filed' or 'furnished' and implications for Securities Act/Exchange Act liability and registration statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.N: discussion of proposed approaches, comments, and final rules on treatment for purposes of these Acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms Amendments — Separate Caption and Cross-Referencing Guidance (S-1, S-3, S-11, S-4, F-3, F-4, Form 10, 20-F, 10-Q, 10-K)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to multiple forms require inclusion of climate-related disclosure in a separately captioned section and provide cross-referencing guidance when disclosure appears elsewhere in the filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendices A–J include model form language: e.g., 'Information required by subpart 1500 ... in a part of the registration statement that is separately captioned as Climate-Related Disclosure.' Cross-referencing may be used to enhance presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by Reference Timing for GHG Emissions Metrics (225-day rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant is required to disclose Scope 1 and/or Scope 2 emissions and incorporates those GHG emissions metrics by reference, the incorporated GHG disclosure must be as of the most recently completed fiscal year that is at least 225 days prior to the date of effectiveness of the registration statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in Form S-3 and F-3 appendices: practical timing rule — e.g., if annual report filed but the Form 10-Q for the necessary quarter hasn't been filed, the registrant must incorporate the prior fiscal year's GHG emissions metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 10-Q Timing for Scope 1/2 Emissions Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant that is required to disclose Scope 1 and/or Scope 2 emissions and elects to provide this disclosure in a Form 10-Q must provide it in its Form 10-Q for the second quarter in the fiscal year immediately following the fiscal year to which those GHG emissions relate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Appendix I (Form 10-Q) language specifying the timing of quarterly filing for emissions metrics tied to fiscal years (i.e., second quarter of the following fiscal year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 20-F Exhibit: Letter from GHG Emissions Attestation Provider
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicable, a letter from the GHG emissions attestation provider acknowledging awareness of the use in a registration statement of a GHG emissions attestation report may be filed with Form 20-F as an exhibit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix H (Form 20-F) Instruction 18: the letter may be filed if Form 20-F is incorporated by reference into a Securities Act registration statement; it acknowledges that the attestation report is not considered part of a registration statement under certain Securities Act provisions (Rule 436(i)(1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Impact Metrics and Expenditure Disclosures (Rules 14-02 etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Require disclosure of specified financial impact metrics and expenditures related to climate-related events and conditions, including thresholds, attribution, recoveries, and presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.K.2–3: detailed discussion of proposed metrics, comments, final rules on scope, disclosure thresholds, attribution principles, alternatives, recoveries, presentation format, and treatment of severe weather events and other natural conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of GHG Emissions Metrics and Underlying Methodologies and Assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants must present GHG emissions metrics alongside disclosure of the underlying methodologies and assumptions used to calculate those metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See II.H.2.b and II.H.3.a–b: includes expectations for clear presentation, disclosure of calculation methods, data sources, conversion factors, and any exclusions or assumptions that materially affect reported metrics.
